decisions.cancel_condition: Cancel if unfilled at valid_until, if any completed H1 candle closes below 209.25 before entry, or if a high-impact GBP/JPY event becomes imminent within 60 minutes before fill.
decisions.exposure_note: Adds 0.25% GBP-long/JPY-short risk. USDCAD and EURUSD previously traded through their proposed entry zones and are treated as potentially active; modeled aggregate risk becomes 0.75%. Their opposing USD legs offset, leaving 0.25% directional exposure each to EUR, CAD, GBP, and JPY—within the 1.0% per-currency cap. Existing account and duplicate-symbol risk remain subject to server-side enforcement.
decisions.reasoning: GBPJPY completed the 08:00 UTC H1 candle at 209.497, 15.25 pips above the prior 20-bar high of 209.3445. The candle added a 20.45-pip bullish body after the London impulse, closed near its high, and retained a tight 0.6-pip closing spread. The 209.36 limit seeks a retest of the broken range rather than chasing; the stop invalidates a return below structure and the target provides 2.50R.

message: TRADE: GBPJPY.x BUY_LIMIT breakout-retest setup selected from a complete fresh 18/18-symbol scan; 0.25% proposed risk, 2.50R, with modeled aggregate and currency exposure within limits.
